text: The people of Paradis Island are not devils.
Zeke is secretly allied with the Survey Corps.
Marleyan wine distributed to the military contains Zeke's spinal fluid.
Zeke's true objective is the biological sterilization of all Eldians.
The Attack Titan can perceive memories sent from future successors.
Eren guided and pressured Grisha into slaughtering the Reiss family.
Eren intends to exterminate all humanity outside Paradis rather than execute a limited deterrence.
Ymir Fritz can exercise free will and is not bound to obey royal commands.
The power of the Titans has permanently vanished from the world.
